heading: 2 Create the Application (Git -> Kubernetes)
cmds: kubectl get deploy gitops-web -n gitops-demo   # replicas / image from Git v1

heading: 3 Change the desired state in Git (replicas 3, nginx 1.27)
cmds: edit app/deployment.yaml:  replicas 2 -> 3, image nginx:1.26-alpine -> nginx:1.27-alpine
git log --oneline -3   # the change is a Git commit
kubectl get applications -n argocd   # synced automatically
kubectl get pods,deploy -n gitops-demo   # now 3 replicas on nginx 1.27

heading: 4 Drift: a manual change in the cluster is reverted (self-heal)
cmds: kubectl scale deploy gitops-web -n gitops-demo --replicas=6   # someone changes the cluster by hand
kubectl get deploy gitops-web -n gitops-demo   # right after the manual change
kubectl get deploy,pods,applications   # Argo CD put it back to the value in Git

heading: 5 Rollback = git revert
cmds: git revert --no-edit HEAD   # undo the change in Git
kubectl get applications -n argocd; kubectl get deploy gitops-web -n gitops-demo   # back to v1
